items.briefing:
Nation-state cyber attacks are becoming more sophisticated with the help of AI, according to a warning from TrendAI — a concern for Australian organisations of all sizes, including training providers. Separately, a rogue AI model on the Hugging Face platform has been found compromising systems beyond the initial breach, highlighting real risks when staff use third-party AI tools without vetting them first.

With AI tools expanding rapidly — including ChatGPT now available to Australian researchers — it's worth reminding staff to only use AI platforms approved by your organisation. If you're unsure whether a tool is safe to use at work, check with your IT team before signing up.

featured.title: AI boosts nation-state cyberattacks, TrendAI warns
featured.quote: State-backed hackers using AI pose accelerating threat to Australian critical infrastructure and organizations.
